name: Duolingo
tagline: Free language learning, one streak at a time
rundown: Duolingo is the world's most popular language-learning app, using bite-sized gamified lessons, streaks, and a famously pushy green owl mascot to keep hundreds of millions of learners coming back. It's free to use, funded by ads and a subscription tier.

timeline.event: Luis von Ahn and Severin Hacker found Duolingo at Carnegie Mellon University.
The app launches publicly, free to use.
Duolingo goes public on the Nasdaq.

notableFacts: Co-founder Luis von Ahn also invented reCAPTCHA.
Its green owl mascot, Duo, is internet-famous for aggressively reminding you to practice.
It's free to use, monetized through ads and its Super/Max subscriptions.
